events.title: Microphone Detection Notice
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who tried the demo. Some players have reported that 'the microphone doesn't respond' — here's a quick clarification. Don't Make a Sound uses your system's default microphone device and relies on Windows microphone permissions. If you're experiencing issues, please try the following: 1. Check Windows microphone permissions: Settings → Privacy → Microphone → Make sure 'Allow apps to access your microphone' is enabled 2. Confirm that the microphone you're using is set as the d

basic_info.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.
